The visibility problem for medical practices

Where the customer slips away, and why.

01

Details drift across listings.

Old hours, a moved suite or a retired provider can linger on Google and in AI answers, and patients call the wrong place.

02

Reviews carry the decision.

Patients read how a practice answers reviews. Silence reads as neglect, and a careless reply can expose private details.

03

Specialists compete street by street.

A patient searching from home sees a different list than one searching from the hospital campus.

Questions

Answers, before you ask.

Is your review response process safe for patient privacy?

Yes. Responses never confirm that someone is a patient and never discuss care. We do not need access to patient records.

Can you fix wrong hours, addresses or provider details?

Yes. Site Read checks your details across your website, your Google profile and AI answers every week, and we correct what is out of date.

Do you work with practices that have several locations?

Yes. Each location is tracked on its own, and portfolio reporting shows every location side by side.

Will this replace our website or patient marketing?

No. LocalLift works alongside them and focuses on how patients find and judge your practice before they call.
